messages:
Kelsey: Apex Labs onboarding — staging SDK init failing with intermittent 401s. They see keepalive pings drop after ~30s then subsequent calls return 401 invalid_token. Happened during CI concurrency ramp. Anyone seen this pattern?

Sam: Can you paste the SDK init snippet or curl? My hunch: ephemeral token refresh TTL or client clock skew.

Kelsey: Here's the init they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdksession/init \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"client_id":"apex-client","keepAlive":true, "refreshWindow":30}'
```
They also reported some requests from mobile webviews with proxies.

Marta: I pulled ingress logs for that window — lots of 401s with message "signature expired" and a spike of preflight calls. Timestamps show ~25–35s drift on some client IPs.

Alejandro: Sounds like two things: (1) ephemeral tokens being refreshed too late because refreshWindow is only 30s, (2) proxy truncating Authorization header or dropping Connection keep-alive. Recommend bump refreshWindow to 90s and add jitter to token refresh.

Sam: Agree. Quick suggested client config:
```
// SDK config
{
  "keepAlive": true,
  "refreshWindow": 90,
  "refreshJitter": 0.25,
  "maxPreflightConcurrency": 6
}
```
Also enable automatic preflight coalescing in the next SDK patch.

Kelsey: I sent the patch recommendation to Apex Labs. They applied refreshWindow=90 and added jitter; 2 mins later errors subsided.

Marta: For safety, I'm opening a soft-throttle on preflight tokens for this tenant at edge (10 req/s) and adding an alert if 401 rate > 5% in 5m.

Sam: I'll create ENG-12345 for an infra guard (preflight splay + header-trim detection) and a dashboard panel for "ephemeral refresh failures".

Kelsey: Customer confirmed onboarding green. They'll keep us posted if it recurs. Thanks team :tada:

oncall-bot: Incident auto-log created: INC-2026-042 (monitoring rule: ephemeral-refresh-error-rate).
